categories.name: Food
categories.definition: Edible groceries for humans, including all descendants of Food; excludes pet food and nonfood goods. Select Food directly when the evidence supports food but no single child is supported, including named foods outside the available children.

categories.name: Dairy
categories.definition: Animal-milk foods and drinks, including all descendants of Dairy; excludes plant alternatives. Select Dairy directly when the evidence supports animal dairy but no single child is supported, including named dairy subtypes outside the available children.

categories.name: Animal milk
categories.definition: Plain unfermented animal drinking milk, including lactose-free and reduced-fat milk. Excludes fermented or cultured milk products, cream, butter, cheese and plant drinks.

categories.name: Cheese
categories.definition: Animal-milk cheese; excludes plant-based cheese substitutes.

categories.name: Plant drinks
categories.definition: Plant-based drinking-milk alternatives, such as drinks made from grains, legumes or nuts; excludes animal dairy and nondrink plant foods.

categories.name: Household
categories.definition: Household cleaning and paper supplies, including all descendants of Household. Select Household directly when the evidence supports this family but no single child is supported, including assortments or alternatives spanning its children. Excludes personal-care products.

categories.name: Cleaning
categories.definition: Laundry, dishwashing and other household detergents; excludes personal-care products.

categories.name: Paper supplies
categories.definition: Toilet paper, paper towels and household tissues.
